snippet.title: Hell's 8th Avenue: Miori's Mysterious Notebook - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Store: https://saikeystudios.com/product/hells-8-avenue-mioris-mysterious-notebook/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3641720/Hells_8th_Avenue_Mioris_Mysterious_Notebook/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=post

In this adventure game, play as Miori, a young detective tasked with finding a missing person and purifying the ominous 'Illusory 8th Street.' Challenge your dexterity with fun Quick Time Events and push forward... or get punished for being too slow.
